task.title: 检查设置详细信息
task.shortdesc: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：检查设置详细信息. Select a setting and inspect its value, source, validation, schema support, and product location.

prereq.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：检查设置详细信息. Open All Settings and select a setting row from Review, Configured, Catalog, search, or a deep link.

context.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：检查设置详细信息. The detail panel is the safe place to understand a single setting before editing it. It shows value shape, source attribution, validation issues, and navigation context.

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：检查设置详细信息. Select the setting row you need to understand.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：检查设置详细信息. Read the current value, source badge, validation messages, and schema/channel support.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：检查设置详细信息. Check the product location or related surface link if the setting is also covered elsewhere.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：检查设置详细信息. Decide whether to edit, remove, reset, or leave the value unchanged.

info.note: 警告：保存前请检查架构、值来源以及更改后果。

result.p: All Settings 显示配置文件的预期状态，并且该操作可在审查时解释。 You understand what the setting does in this profile and what action is safe next.

postreq.p: 恢复：如果结果不符合预期，请清除筛选器、返回详细信息面板或打开相关主题。 Recovery: if the value shape is unclear, compare with JSON Editor or leave the setting unchanged until validation guidance is available.
